_comment: B.A — University of the Punjab catalog. The legacy 2-year B.A (Annual System) is officially REPLACED by 2-year/4-semester Associate Degree programs (and 4-year BS). Classes 101/102 (annual scheme) are archived references; class 103 is the current Associate Degree program. Subjects = PU course-outline lists (official); no single authorized textbook is prescribed by PU for these programs, so rows are subject-level with 'syllabus = PU course outline' notes.
